sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the summoning order dated 01.02.2017 and NBW dated 06.06.2023 as well as entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 4549 of 2016 (Aftab Vs. Khurram), under Sections 420, 323, 504, 506 IPC,
Police Station Banna Devi, District Aligarh, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Aligarh.
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicants has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicants are ready to appear before the court below and seek their bail and that their release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.

5. In view of the above, in case the applicants appear before the court below within three weeks from today and seek bail, thier release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
6.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.
